title: Request bodies
description: Every request body, one definition per operation family. Referenced from openapi.yaml.

credential.description: A local credential configured on the hub (PIN or passphrase). Never a config document.

ConfigReleaseCreate.description: Documents not listed keep their active version.

GroundLinkDemoSwitch.description: Demo only. Either use_schedule true (return to the profile's schedule) or a status with an optional delay and next contact. With status down, gap_kind defaults to the profile's link default_gap_kind and gap_planned to false.

OverlayCreate.description: Give planned_start to plan, started_at to start now.

OverrideCreate.description: Starts a manual trigger. Crew medical officer or ground only.

condition_ids.description: ICL conditions the result would help confirm; echoed in kit_check with their CliFF links.

KitMapWhatIf.description: At least one of add_instruments, add_supplies or add_skills. environment_id defaults to the active environment. Nothing is stored.

offline_path.description: Answers given on the cached first screen before the hub answered; replayed in order.

HelpSessionCreate.description: A red flag entry gives flow_id from help-presentation red_flag_flows and opens straight on that flow.

GroundMessageCreate.description: previewed_sha256: the text_sha256 of the GroundMessagePreview on the card when the person pressed Tell the ground. The hub queues the draft as it stands and records both; it never refuses the press.

PlanRunCreate.description: Exactly one of episode_id or help_session_id. The environment is the active one; the run pins its configuration.

GuidedCheckCreate.description: At most one of plan_run_id or drill_id. The helper may never be the subject (ROLE_NOT_ELIGIBLE).

GuidedCheckBeat.description: One tap on Beat. The hub records its own receive time; sequence makes retries idempotent.

DrillComplete.description: participant_ids: who completed it, when not everyone did. No measurement is accepted here.

text.description: The ground's reply, shown to the crew as it is. Not a clinical review.

finding.description: The pharmacy engine's inspection vocabulary (contracts/pharmacy/inputs.schema.json InspectionRecord); any finding other than no_change excludes the lot at once.

MedicineAssayCreate.description: One measured assay of an ingredient of a lot (pharmacy AssayRecord); scheduling an assessment follows (E32 4.4).
